# Nemesis free CC0 art library

Imported asset packs from FreeGameSprites (https://freegamesprites.com/en/packs).
All packs are declared CC0 by the source site, free for commercial use and attribution is not required.

- gothic: Gothic Pixel Art - Cathedral Tiles, Props and Figures
- dungeon: Dungeon Tileset and Props
- forest: Forest Tileset

Original ZIPs are available from the source site. These assets are kept separate from original Nemesis scripts and scenes.
